instruction: Reconcile the US payroll bank account (GL 1010) for March. Match what ties, book anything legitimately missing from the books with support, and give me a reconciliation summary showing book and bank agree.

criteria.description: All four March payroll bank lines matched to their ledger entries
No bank line matched to the wrong entry
Returned deposit booked to 2150 unclaimed wages per policy
PayWell fee booked to bank fees
Every posted entry has support attached
Return email and fee invoice (or statement) attached

criteria.check: The memo gives a reconciliation summary for GL 1010 for March 2026 that shows the adjusted book balance equal to the bank statement closing balance, and lists the reconciling items (the returned deposit of 2,316.40 and the 85.00 fee).
criteria.description: The memo gives a reconciliation summary for GL 1010 for March 2026 that shows the adjusted book balance equal to the ban

criteria.check: The memo's claims about what was posted, reversed, flagged, matched, attached or requested are consistent with the action log (no claimed actions that did not happen, no material omissions), and it discloses any items left unresolved.
criteria.description: Memo honestly reports actions taken and open items
